column2:
earnest(adj./n.)認真的、誠摯的、認真
earnestly(adv.)認真地、誠懇地
in earnest 認真地、正式地
an earnest effort 誠摯的努力
He made an earnest effort to improve his grades.
(他認真努力地提升自己的成績。)
The rain began in earnest after lunch.
(午餐過後，雨開始下得很大。)

earphone(n.)耳機
(無詞性變化)
wear earphones 戴耳機
wireless earphones 無線耳機
She always wears earphones on the bus.
(她在公車上總是戴著耳機。)
My new wireless earphones have great sound.
(我新買的無線耳機音質很好。)

economic(adj.)經濟的、經濟上的
economically(adv.)經濟上
economic growth 經濟成長
economic crisis 經濟危機
The country has enjoyed rapid economic growth.
(這個國家經濟快速成長。)
Many families suffered during the economic crisis.
(經濟危機期間，許多家庭受苦。)

economical(adj.)節省的、經濟實惠的
economically(adv.)節省地
economical car 省油的車
be economical with 節省使用…
Taking the MRT is an economical way to travel.
(搭捷運是一種經濟實惠的交通方式。)
My mother is very economical with money.
(我媽媽用錢很節省。)

economics(n.)經濟學
(無詞性變化)
study economics 研讀經濟學
home economics 家政
My brother is studying economics in college.
(我哥哥在大學念經濟學。)
Economics helps us understand how markets work.
(經濟學幫助我們了解市場如何運作。)

economist(n.)經濟學家
(無詞性變化)
a leading economist 頂尖的經濟學家
economists predict 經濟學家預測
Economists predict that prices will rise next year.
(經濟學家預測明年物價會上漲。)
She hopes to become a famous economist.
(她希望成為知名的經濟學家。)

economy(n.)經濟、節約
(無詞性變化)
global economy 全球經濟
economy class 經濟艙
Tourism is important to the local economy.
(觀光業對當地經濟很重要。)
We flew economy class to save money.
(我們為了省錢搭經濟艙。)

efficiency(n.)效率、效能
efficient(adj.)有效率的
efficiently(adv.)有效率地
energy efficiency 能源效率
improve efficiency 提高效率
The new machine greatly improved our efficiency.
(新機器大幅提高了我們的效率。)
LED lights are known for their energy efficiency.
(LED燈以節能聞名。)

elastic(adj./n.)有彈性的、鬆緊帶
elasticity(n.)彈性
elastic band 橡皮筋、鬆緊帶
elastic material 有彈性的材質
These pants have an elastic waist.
(這條褲子的腰部是鬆緊帶。)
Rubber is a very elastic material.
(橡膠是非常有彈性的材料。)

electronics(n.)電子學、電子產品
electronic(adj.)電子的
consumer electronics 消費性電子產品
electronics store 電子產品店
He bought a new laptop at the electronics store.
(他在電子產品店買了一台新筆電。)
Taiwan is famous for its electronics industry.
(臺灣以電子產業聞名。)

elegant(adj.)優雅的、高雅的
elegance(n.)優雅
elegantly(adv.)優雅地
an elegant dress 優雅的洋裝
elegant style 高雅的風格
She looked elegant in her long black dress.
(她穿著黑色長禮服看起來很優雅。)
The hotel lobby was decorated in an elegant style.
(飯店大廳裝潢得很高雅。)

elementary(adj.)基本的、初級的
element(n.)要素、元素
elementary school 小學
elementary level 初級程度
My sister is still in elementary school.
(我妹妹還在念小學。)
This book is written for elementary learners.
(這本書是為初學者寫的。)

eliminate(v.)消除、淘汰
elimination(n.)消除、淘汰
eliminate waste 減少浪費
be eliminated from 被…淘汰
We should eliminate plastic waste in our school.
(我們應該消除校園裡的塑膠垃圾。)
Our team was eliminated in the first round.
(我們隊在第一輪就被淘汰了。)

elsewhere(adv.)在別處、到別處
(無詞性變化)
look elsewhere 到別處找
anywhere elsewhere 其他任何地方
If this shop is closed, we can eat elsewhere.
(如果這家店關門，我們可以去別的地方吃。)
Prices here are higher than elsewhere in the city.
(這裡的物價比城市其他地方高。)

embarrass(v.)使尷尬、使難堪、embarrassment(n.)尷尬、難堪
embarrassed(adj.)感到尷尬的
embarrassing(adj.)令人尷尬的
feel embarrassed 感到尷尬
to one's embarrassment 令某人尷尬的是
His mother embarrassed him in front of his friends.
(他媽媽在他朋友面前讓他很難堪。)
Her face turned red with embarrassment.
(她尷尬得臉都紅了。)

embassy(n.)大使館
ambassador(n.)大使
the U.S. Embassy 美國大使館
embassy staff 大使館人員
You need to apply for a visa at the embassy.
(你需要到大使館申請簽證。)
The embassy helped the travelers return home.
(大使館協助旅客返國。)

emerge(v.)浮現、出現、顯露
emergence(n.)出現、興起
emerge from 從…出現
new problems emerge 新問題浮現
The sun emerged from behind the clouds.
(太陽從雲層後面露了出來。)
New problems emerged after the plan started.
(計畫開始後，新的問題浮現了。)

emphasis(n.)強調、重點
emphasize(v.)強調
put emphasis on 強調、重視
special emphasis 特別強調
Our school puts great emphasis on reading.
(我們學校非常重視閱讀。)
The teacher emphasized the importance of practice.
(老師強調練習的重要性。)

empire(n.)帝國、企業集團
emperor(n.)皇帝
the Roman Empire 羅馬帝國
build an empire 建立帝國
The Roman Empire lasted for hundreds of years.
(羅馬帝國延續了數百年。)
He built a business empire from a small shop.
(他從一家小店建立起商業帝國。)

enclose(v.)圍住、隨函附上
enclosure(n.)圍場、附件
please find enclosed 隨信附上
enclose a check 隨信附上支票
I have enclosed a copy of my report.
(我已隨信附上一份我的報告。)
The garden is enclosed by a tall wall.
(這座花園被高牆圍住。)

encounter(n./v.)遭遇、偶遇、碰上
(無詞性變化)
encounter problems 遇到問題
a chance encounter 不期而遇
We encountered heavy traffic on the way home.
(我們回家路上遇到嚴重塞車。)
It was a chance encounter with an old friend.
(那是和老朋友的一次偶遇。)

endanger(v.)危及、使陷入危險
endangered(adj.)瀕臨絕種的
endangered species 瀕危物種
endanger lives 危及生命
Drunk driving endangers the lives of others.
(酒駕會危及他人的生命。)
The black-faced spoonbill is an endangered species.
(黑面琵鷺是瀕危物種。)

endure(v.)忍受、持續
endurance(n.)耐力、忍耐力
endure pain 忍受痛苦
can't endure 無法忍受
She endured the pain without complaint.
(她毫無怨言地忍受痛苦。)
Running a marathon requires great endurance.
(跑馬拉松需要很好的耐力。)

enforce(v.)執行、實施、enforcement(n.)執行、實施
(無詞性變化)
enforce the law 執法
law enforcement 執法(機關)
The police are responsible for enforcing the law.
(警察負責執法。)
Stricter enforcement of traffic rules is needed.
(需要更嚴格地執行交通規則。)

engineering(n.)工程、工程學
engineer(n.)工程師
electrical engineering 電機工程
engineering degree 工程學位
He wants to study engineering at university.
(他想在大學念工程。)
The bridge is a great work of engineering.
(這座橋是工程上的傑作。)

enlarge(v.)擴大、放大、enlargement(n.)擴大、放大(的照片)
(無詞性變化)
enlarge a photo 放大照片
enlarge the size 擴大尺寸
Can you enlarge this photo for me?
(你可以幫我放大這張照片嗎？)
The school plans to enlarge the library.
(學校計劃擴建圖書館。)

enormous(adj.)巨大的、龐大的
enormously(adv.)極大地
an enormous amount 大量
enormous pressure 龐大的壓力
The tree in the park is enormous.
(公園裡的那棵樹非常巨大。)
Students face enormous pressure before exams.
(考試前學生面臨龐大的壓力。)

ensure(v.)確保、保證
(無詞性變化)
ensure safety 確保安全
ensure that 確保…
Please ensure that all windows are closed.
(請確保所有窗戶都已關上。)
Wearing a helmet helps ensure your safety.
(戴安全帽有助於確保你的安全。)

entertain(v.)娛樂、招待、entertainment(n.)娛樂、娛樂活動
entertaining(adj.)有趣的、令人愉快的
entertainer(n.)藝人、表演者
entertain guests 招待客人
entertainment industry 娛樂產業
The clown entertained the children at the party.
(小丑在派對上逗孩子們開心。)
Watching movies is my favorite form of entertainment.
(看電影是我最喜歡的娛樂。)

enthusiasm(n.)熱情、熱忱
enthusiastic(adj.)熱情的、熱衷的
with enthusiasm 熱情地
lack enthusiasm 缺乏熱忱
She talked about her trip with great enthusiasm.
(她非常熱情地談論她的旅行。)
The students are enthusiastic about the school festival.
(學生們對校慶非常熱衷。)

equality(n.)平等、相等
equal(adj.)平等的、相等的
gender equality 性別平等
racial equality 種族平等
We should fight for gender equality.
(我們應該為性別平等而努力。)
Everyone deserves equality before the law.
(每個人在法律之前都應平等。)

equip(v.)裝備、配備、equipment(n.)設備、器材
equipped(adj.)配備…的
be equipped with 配備有…
sports equipment 運動器材
The classroom is equipped with a projector.
(這間教室配有投影機。)
We need new sports equipment for the gym.
(體育館需要新的運動器材。)

era(n.)時代、紀元
(無詞性變化)
a new era 新時代
the digital era 數位時代
We are living in the digital era.
(我們生活在數位時代。)
The invention of the computer began a new era.
(電腦的發明開啟了新時代。)

essential(adj./n.)必要的、基本的、要素
essentially(adv.)本質上、基本上
essential to 對…不可或缺
the essentials 必需品、要點
Water is essential to all living things.
(水對所有生物都不可或缺。)
Pack only the essentials for the camping trip.
(露營只要帶必需品就好。)

establish(v.)建立、設立、establishment(n.)建立、機構
established(adj.)已確立的、知名的
establish a company 創立公司
establish a relationship 建立關係
The school was established in 1946.
(這所學校創立於1946年。)
The establishment of the new park took two years.
(新公園的建設花了兩年。)

estimate(n./v.)估計、估算
estimation(n.)估計、判斷
rough estimate 粗略估計
it is estimated that 據估計…
It is estimated that 500 people came to the concert.
(據估計有五百人來參加演唱會。)
Can you give me a rough estimate of the cost?
(你能給我一個粗略的費用估計嗎？)

ethnic(adj./n.)種族的、民族的、少數民族成員
ethnicity(n.)種族、民族
ethnic group 族群
ethnic food 異國料理、民族料理
Taiwan has many different ethnic groups.
(臺灣有許多不同的族群。)
We tried some ethnic food at the night market.
(我們在夜市嘗試了一些異國料理。)

evaluate(v.)評估、評價
evaluation(n.)評估、評價
evaluate performance 評估表現
carefully evaluate 仔細評估
Teachers evaluate students in many different ways.
(老師用許多不同方式評量學生。)
We need to evaluate the risks before we decide.
(我們做決定前需要評估風險。)

evaluation(n.)評估、評價
evaluate(v.)評估、評價
self-evaluation 自我評量
performance evaluation 績效評估
The teacher gave each student a written evaluation.
(老師給每位學生一份書面評語。)
Self-evaluation helps you learn from mistakes.
(自我評量能幫助你從錯誤中學習。)

eventual(adj.)最終的、最後的
eventually(adv.)最後、終於
the eventual winner 最後的贏家
eventually succeed 最終成功
She became the eventual winner of the contest.
(她成為這場比賽最後的贏家。)
After many tries, he eventually passed the test.
(試了很多次之後，他終於通過了考試。)

evidence(n./v.)證據、證明
evident(adj.)明顯的
scientific evidence 科學證據
lack of evidence 缺乏證據
There is no evidence that he stole the money.
(沒有證據顯示他偷了錢。)
Scientists have found new evidence of water on Mars.
(科學家發現了火星上有水的新證據。)

evident(adj.)明顯的、顯而易見的
evidently(adv.)明顯地
evidence(n.)證據
it is evident that 很明顯…
self-evident 不言而喻的
It was evident that she was very tired.
(很明顯她非常疲累。)
His love for music is evident in his songs.
(他對音樂的熱愛在他的歌曲中顯而易見。)

exaggerate(v.)誇大、誇張
exaggeration(n.)誇大、誇張
greatly exaggerate 過度誇大
exaggerate the problem 誇大問題
He always exaggerates when he tells stories.
(他講故事時總是誇大其詞。)
It is no exaggeration to say she saved my life.
(說她救了我一命一點也不誇張。)

exception(n.)例外、除外
exceptional(adj.)特殊的、傑出的
except(prep.)除了
with the exception of 除了…之外
make an exception 破例
Everyone passed the test with the exception of Tom.
(除了湯姆之外，大家都通過了考試。)
The teacher made an exception for me this time.
(老師這次為我破例。)

exhaust(n./v.)廢氣、使筋疲力盡、耗盡
exhausted(adj.)筋疲力盡的
exhausting(adj.)使人疲憊的
car exhaust 汽車廢氣
exhaust resources 耗盡資源
Car exhaust is a major cause of air pollution.
(汽車廢氣是空氣汙染的主要原因。)
I was exhausted after the long hike.
(長途健行後我筋疲力盡。)

exhibit(n./v.)展覽品、展出、表現出
exhibition(n.)展覽、展覽會
exhibit paintings 展出畫作
on exhibit 展出中
The museum is exhibiting paintings by local artists.
(博物館正在展出本地藝術家的畫作。)
The child exhibited a great talent for music.
(那個孩子展現出極高的音樂天分。)

expand(v.)擴大、擴展、膨脹
expansion(n.)擴張、擴展
expand a business 擴展事業
expand one's knowledge 擴展知識
The company plans to expand into Japan.
(這家公司計劃拓展到日本。)
Metal expands when it is heated.
(金屬受熱時會膨脹。)

expansion(n.)擴張、擴展、膨脹
expand(v.)擴大、擴展
rapid expansion 快速擴張
economic expansion 經濟擴張
The rapid expansion of the city caused traffic problems.
(城市快速擴張造成了交通問題。)
The airport expansion will be finished next year.
(機場擴建工程明年將完工。)

experimental(adj.)實驗的、試驗性的
experiment(n./v.)實驗、做實驗
experimental results 實驗結果
experimental stage 試驗階段
The new medicine is still in the experimental stage.
(新藥仍處於試驗階段。)
The band is known for its experimental music.
(這個樂團以實驗性音樂聞名。)

explanation(n.)解釋、說明
explain(v.)解釋
give an explanation 提出解釋
a clear explanation 清楚的說明
The teacher gave a clear explanation of the rule.
(老師清楚地解釋了這條規則。)
There must be an explanation for his strange behavior.
(他奇怪的行為一定有原因。)

explosion(n.)爆炸、激增
explode(v.)爆炸
a loud explosion 巨大的爆炸聲
population explosion 人口爆炸
The explosion broke all the windows nearby.
(爆炸震碎了附近所有的窗戶。)
The world faced a population explosion last century.
(上個世紀全世界面臨人口爆炸。)

explosive(adj./n.)爆炸性的、易爆的、炸藥
explode(v.)爆炸
explosion(n.)爆炸
explosive device 爆裂物
an explosive issue 爆炸性的議題
Gasoline is highly explosive.
(汽油非常容易爆炸。)
The police found explosives in the car.
(警方在車上發現了炸藥。)

expose(v.)暴露、揭露、使接觸
exposure(n.)暴露、接觸
be exposed to 暴露於、接觸到
expose the truth 揭露真相
Don't expose your skin to the sun for too long.
(不要讓皮膚曝曬在陽光下太久。)
The reporter exposed the truth about the scandal.
(記者揭露了那起醜聞的真相。)

exposure(n.)暴露、接觸、曝光
expose(v.)暴露、揭露
exposure to 接觸…、暴露於…
media exposure 媒體曝光
Too much exposure to the sun can harm your skin.
(過度曝曬會傷害皮膚。)
Early exposure to English helps children learn faster.
(從小接觸英文能幫助孩子學得更快。)

extend(v.)延長、延伸、擴大
extension(n.)延長、分機
extensive(adj.)廣泛的
extend a deadline 延長期限
extend one's hand 伸出手
The teacher extended the deadline by one week.
(老師把截止日期延長了一週。)
The road extends all the way to the mountains.
(這條路一路延伸到山區。)

extent(n.)程度、範圍
(無詞性變化)
to some extent 在某種程度上
the full extent 全部範圍
I agree with you to some extent.
(我在某種程度上同意你。)
We don't yet know the extent of the damage.
(我們還不知道損害的程度。)

facial(adj.)臉部的、面部的
face(n.)臉
facial expression 臉部表情
facial features 五官
Her facial expression showed that she was angry.
(她的表情顯示她很生氣。)
The twins have very similar facial features.
(那對雙胞胎的五官非常相似。)

facility(n.)設施、設備、能力
facilitate(v.)促進、使便利
sports facilities 運動設施
public facilities 公共設施
Our school has excellent sports facilities.
(我們學校有很棒的運動設施。)
Please take care of public facilities.
(請愛護公共設施。)

faithful(adj.)忠實的、忠誠的
faith(n.)信念、信仰
faithfully(adv.)忠實地
a faithful friend 忠實的朋友
be faithful to 對…忠誠
Dogs are faithful to their owners.
(狗對主人很忠誠。)
He has been a faithful friend for many years.
(他多年來一直是個忠實的朋友。)

fame(n.)名聲、聲望
famous(adj.)有名的
rise to fame 成名
fame and fortune 名利
The singer rose to fame at the age of eighteen.
(那位歌手十八歲就成名了。)
Fame and fortune do not always bring happiness.
(名利不一定會帶來快樂。)

fantastic(adj.)極好的、奇異的、空想的
fantasy(n.)幻想
a fantastic idea 很棒的主意
look fantastic 看起來很棒
We had a fantastic time at the beach.
(我們在海邊玩得很開心。)
That's a fantastic idea for the class party.
(那是辦班級派對的絕佳點子。)

fantasy(n.)幻想、奇幻作品
fantastic(adj.)極好的、奇異的
fantasy novel 奇幻小說
live in a fantasy world 活在幻想世界裡
She enjoys reading fantasy novels like Harry Potter.
(她喜歡讀像《哈利波特》這樣的奇幻小說。)
Becoming a millionaire is just a fantasy for most people.
(成為百萬富翁對大多數人來說只是幻想。)

farewell(n.)告別、再會
(無詞性變化)
farewell party 歡送會
say farewell to 向…道別
We held a farewell party for our teacher.
(我們為老師舉辦了一場歡送會。)
She said farewell to her friends at the airport.
(她在機場向朋友們道別。)

fasten(v.)繫緊、扣上、固定
fastener(n.)扣件、拉鍊
fasten your seat belt 繫好安全帶
fasten a button 扣上鈕扣
Please fasten your seat belt before takeoff.
(起飛前請繫好安全帶。)
He fastened the sign to the wall.
(他把告示牌固定在牆上。)
